module.purpose: Provides NestJS error translation for booking-related failures in the dated enterprise bookings API service.
module.summary: This injectable service centralizes construction of HTTP exceptions for missing event types and booking failures. It selects contextual not-found messages from booking lookup fields, maps recognized domain errors to bad-request responses, and rethrows unknown errors unchanged. The service is synchronous and exception-driven, with no persistent state beyond a constructed logger.
module.businessContext: Supports booking creation APIs by returning actionable errors when event types are missing or scheduling constraints prevent booking. Failures affect API correctness and client guidance.

units.name: handleEventTypeToBeBookedNotFound

detail.name: handleEventTypeToBeBookedNotFound
invariants: The method always throws exactly one NotFoundException before completing.
edgeCases: When username and eventTypeSlug are truthy and organizationSlug is falsy, throws a user-scoped event-type not-found message.
When username, eventTypeSlug, and organizationSlug are all truthy, throws an organization-scoped user event-type not-found message.
When teamSlug and eventTypeSlug are truthy and organizationSlug is falsy, throws a team-scoped event-type not-found message.
When teamSlug, eventTypeSlug, and organizationSlug are all truthy and the username condition does not apply, throws an organization-scoped team event-type not-found message.
When none of the preceding conditions match, including when eventTypeSlug is falsy, throws an event-type-by-id not-found message using eventTypeId.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws NotFoundException using the eventTypeId fallback message when the identifying field combinations do not match a scoped event-type case.

detail.summary: Always throws a NotFoundException describing the missing event type according to the identifying fields present in the booking input.

units.name: handleBookingError

detail.name: handleBookingError
preconditions: error may contain any runtime value.
postconditions: Recognized Error messages are converted to BadRequestException with the corresponding contractual message.
Unrecognized errors, including non-Error values, are rethrown unchanged.
invariants: The input error is not mutated.
No state is persisted or modified by this method.
edgeCases: An Error with message "no_available_users_found_error" throws the team-host availability message when bookingTeamEventType is true.
An Error with message "no_available_users_found_error" throws the single-user availability message when bookingTeamEventType is false.
An Error with message "booking_time_out_of_bounds_error" throws the full scheduling-window and slots-endpoint guidance message.
An Error with message "Attempting to book a meeting in the past." throws a BadRequestException with the same message.
An Error with message "hosts_unavailable_for_booking" throws the host availability message.
An Error with any other message, or any non-Error value, is rethrown unchanged.

raises: the original input error for unrecognized errors
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Unrecognized errors and non-Error values are rethrown unchanged.

detail.summary: Translates recognized booking failure errors into BadRequestException instances with contextual messages, while rethrowing unrecognized errors unchanged.
